      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/net.cpp and src/net.h to deduplicate -addnode entries and unify added-node connection tracking.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents redundant connection attempts, DNS lookups, and log spam from duplicate startup -addnode values while fixing peer-matching inconsistencies in AddedNodesContain. Commit 486e97266a notes that non-canonical IP spellings previously bypassed AddedNodesContain checks and could consume automatic outbound connection slots."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/rpc/net.cpp to apply unified node equivalence matching to `addnode remove` and `getaddednodeinfo`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes an RPC inconsistency where `addnode remove` failed for equivalent node representations that `addnode add` rejected as duplicates. Commit 59d428d730 notes that addnode remove only matched exact strings, causing remove calls to fail for nodes reported as already added."
    }
